kpis.description_fr: Industrial = ~50% du CA ADI (instrumentation, automation, énergie, défense, healthcare). Cycle de destockage post-2023 en fin. Recovery attendue.
kpis.description_en: Industrial = ~50% of ADI revenue (instrumentation, automation, energy, defense, healthcare). Post-2023 destocking ending. Recovery expected.

kpis.description_fr: Automotive : ADAS, BMS (Battery Management Systems EV), GMSL (in-cabin video). Pricing power durable. Soft cycle 2024-25.
kpis.description_en: Automotive: ADAS, BMS (EV battery management), GMSL (in-cabin video). Durable pricing power. Soft 2024-25 cycle.

kpis.description_fr: Communications (5G base stations RF, data center power). Recul lié au cycle 5G en pause. Recovery dépend du déploiement IA datacenter.
kpis.description_en: Communications (5G base stations RF, data center power). Decline due to 5G cycle pause. Recovery hinges on AI datacenter buildout.

kpis.description_fr: Consumer (haut de gamme audio, hearable, portable). Plus petit segment ADI. Volatile.
kpis.description_en: Consumer (premium audio, hearables, portables). Smallest ADI segment. Volatile.

kpis.description_fr: Asia Pacific = ~53% du CA ADI. Forte dépendance Chine industrielle + Taiwan/Korea semi-conducteurs. Exposition géopolitique élevée.
kpis.description_en: Asia Pacific = ~53% of ADI revenue. High dependency China industrial + Taiwan/Korea semis. Elevated geopolitical exposure.
